trigger.detail: User decided E3c executes only the 100-household scale point; 500 and 1000 are not executed in this paper cycle.

changes.claim_boundary: Scale/efficiency claims are limited to the 100-household envelope (2 seeds). No 500/1000 stability, throughput, or maximum-stable-size claim may be made; the master-plan minimum 'three scale points' is consciously downgraded by user decision.

note: This amendment does not alter E1/E2/E3a or the 100-household protocol itself; it only records the deliberate non-execution of 500/1000.
